svg.title: Creatinine and urea under different missing-data rules

cc:Work.dc:title: Creatinine and urea under different missing-data rules
cc:Work.dc:description: 380 paired measurements show a long upper tail, including row 22 at creatinine 76 and urea 180 mg/dL. After complete-case selection, Pearson r changes by +0.31 and Spearman rho by -0.23.
